name: The Resort at Kapalua Bay
insider_take: Perched on 24 oceanfront acres where Maui's dramatic coastline meets championship golf, this Forbes Five-Star sanctuary epitomizes Hawaiian luxury with unparalleled views of Molokai and the Pacific.
whats_special: Every residence features a private lanai overlooking the crystal-clear waters of Kapalua Bay, one of the world's best beaches. The resort sits adjacent to the legendary Plantation Course, host to the PGA Tour's Sentry Tournament of Champions, while the nearby Kapalua Coastal Trail offers breathtaking cliff-top walks through native Hawaiian flora.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Cane & Canoe restaurant during winter months (December-April) for the best chance to spot migrating humpback whales from your table.
dont_miss: The Dragon's Teeth rock formation at nearby Makaluapuna Point, accessible via a scenic 10-minute walk. These unique lava rock spires create dramatic photo opportunities, especially during golden hour, and offer some of Maui's most Instagram-worthy coastal views.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location on pristine Kapalua Bay
Access to world-class Kapalua Golf Resort facilities
Luxurious St. Regis signature service and amenities
Exclusive Marriott STARS Program benefits and perks
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Remote Kapalua location requires travel time to other Maui areas
